label: UI Event
short_description: Bind a signal on a UI object
long_description: Provides bidirectional event access to a signal on a UI object. The emit port fires the named signal on the UI object; the received callback fires when the UI emits the signal (e.g. a button click).

parameters.name: Object
parameters.description: Name of the UI object to bind to (matches the object's name in the UI definition).

parameters.name: Signal
parameters.description: Name of the signal on the UI object to emit and listen for.
